MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "Heat shrink tubing fits my battery holder, relay, and circuit-board projects because it helps insulate wiring connections.",
    "Test leads and alligator clips are natural next choices because they let me make temporary connections while testing breadboard circuits."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The filament and BLTouch accessory assume a 3D printing need that my history does not establish.",
    "An inspection camera needs a specific inspection job, and permanent splice connectors need a wiring repair; neither is something I need now.",
    "Flashing RGB LEDs do not follow naturally from buying a kit with LEDs, especially when I already have components and no decorative lighting project."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My interest in hands-on electronics seems to have been stretched into an assumed interest in 3D printing supplies.",
    "Items seem to be treated as useful simply because they belong in a workshop, even when they serve very different tasks."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My breadboards, battery holder, relay, and component kit point toward connecting, testing, and insulating small circuits.",
    "I choose supplies when they solve a concrete project need; a related tool or component alone is not enough to make me buy.",
    "Owning a component kit can mean I already have enough LEDs, rather than that I need more specialized versions."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "You recognized my practical electronics interests but stretched them into unsupported printing and specialized-tool needs."
}
